# Runtime Charter Claim Map

- CLAIM-FRESH-OBSERVED: observed claims require fresh bundle evidence.
- CLAIM-STALE-OBSERVED: stale observed claims require downgrade suggestions.
- CLAIM-MISSING-ARTIFACT: missing artifact claims must alarm.
- CLAIM-DEGRADED-ARTIFACT: degraded artifact claims must alarm.
- CLAIM-TARGET-ALLOWED: target wording remains allowed.
- CLAIM-HYPOTHESIS-ALLOWED: hypothesis wording remains allowed.
